description.value: Bonus to Crafting checks to repair or jury-rig airlocks, filtration systems, and pressure seals, and a bonus to saves against inhaled toxins and gas hazards specifically — the drill was never actually about the door.

cinderfall.incomplete: The card states a bonus but gives no numeric value, bonus type, or specific action tag to build a FlatModifier from without inventing one. on both the Crafting bonus and the save bonus.
